name: @dome/brand
description: DoMe brand identity: editable SVG wordmark/icon sources, BRAND.md, and the dependency-free export script that renders exports/

scripts.lint: xmllint --noout icon.svg icon-dark.svg icon-mono.svg wordmark.svg wordmark-dark.svg && ../mobile-app/node_modules/.bin/eslint .
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm export:check
